visualCharacteristics: Full-width discography rows on a dark background; each row pairs square cover art (left) with a release year, an eyebrow format label, a bold title, a numbered track list separated by hairline rules, an optional embedded music video, and a dense grid of streaming-platform link buttons under a 'Listen On' label.
contentPattern: Repeating list of release items. Each item = image cell (cover) + body cell (format label, title heading, ordered track list, optional YouTube video link, streaming platform links).
usage: Discography / release listing pairing cover art with track details and streaming call-to-action links.
